Subject: Order Form / MSA - commercial decision log & outstanding billing questions

Elliot — attaching our draft redlines to the order form (PDF stub attached) and a short decision log for the commercials we discussed on Friday. Key items we still need confirmation on:

- Minimum commit phasing: Kestrel asked for a staircase (Year 1: 40% upfront, Year 2: 60%), but finance needs a monthly invoicing path for usage over threshold. Can you confirm if procurement will accept quarterly invoices against the committed units?
- Net terms: Kestrel procurement requested Net 60. Our standard is Net 30 for first enterprise customers. Is Net 45 an option?
- Tax and withholding: you mentioned your legal team will provide a tax residency certificate. Please provide the redacted cert and confirm if Kestrel requires us to gross-up invoices or if they will handle withholding.

Attached: Kestrel_Redline_OrderForm_20270516.pdf (redline), Decision_Log_OrderForm_20270517.xlsx (proposed internal decisions).

If you can answer the three bullets this week we can route the final O/F to legal for signature next week. Happy to hop on a 30m call if easier.

Thanks,
Ben Carter

Ben — thanks for the redlines and the decision log. A few quick replies while our legal team reviews the attachments: 

- Invoicing cadence: Procurement prefers quarterly invoices. That said, they will accept monthly invoicing only if we provide a single consolidated billing entity and a PO referencing the committed amounts. I'll confirm by EOD.
- Net terms: We can move to Net 45 but need approval from Finance (internal). I'll flag that in the PO.
- Tax: Attached is the tax residency stub they can initially share; legal will follow with a signed certificate next week. Kestrel will not gross-up — they will withhold if required by local law.

Also, procurement asked whether Redwood can include a short clause in the order form specifying who is responsible for VAT/GST registration when services are consumed in multiple jurisdictions.

I'll coordinate with Camila and procurement and come back with a single consolidated reply and the cert.

Best,

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Order Form / MSA - commercial decision log & outstanding billing questions (internal)

Team — quick internal decision log notes to be sent back to Kestrel (I've updated the Decision_Log_OrderForm_20270517.xlsx):

1) Minimum commit phasing: Accept staircase but require invoicing against committed units quarterly. If they want monthly invoicing, require a Finance-approved PO and additional admin fee (0.5% of quarterly committed value) to cover billing ops. Rationale: monthly increases O/P complexity.

2) Net terms: Counteroffer Net 45 for signed annuals with upfront 40% in Year 1; Net 30 by default for renewals. If Kestrel insists on Net 60, require credit review and increase in advance payment or security (escrow) clause.

3) Taxes: Acknowledge receipt of the tax residency stub. Ask for full signed certificate before signature. For VAT/GST: we'll add an explicit clause allocating tax responsibility to the purchaser except where Redwood is required by law to collect — standard carve-outs. Also ask for confirmation on any EU consumption jurisdictions to plan invoicing entity.

4) PO and invoicing entity: Require Kestrel to nominate the invoicing entity on the PO. If multiple entities, map each to the committed tranches (we can support multi-entity but need lead time).

5) Attachments: add Kestrel_Redline_OrderForm_20270516.pdf back with tracked changes accepted for commercials only; legal will handle MSA cross-references.

Action items: Ben to confirm the 0.5% admin fee language in the external reply; Karthik to prepare Net 45 amendment language; Priyom to draft the VAT allocation clause and insert into the O/F redline.

-Marissa
Head of Sales Ops — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elliot Barnes <elliot.barnes@kestrel.ai>
Cc: Camila Ortiz <camila.ortiz@kestrel.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Order Form / MSA - commercial decision log & outstanding billing questions

Elliot — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the tax stub. Per internal alignment (summary below):

- Invoicing cadence: We can accept quarterly invoicing by default. If Kestrel requires monthly invoices against committed units, we can accommodate but will add a 0.5% billing administration fee on the committed amount to cover operational overhead. Please confirm which cadence procurement prefers.
- Net terms: Our commercial partner team can move to Net 45 for this deal (KST-2027-052) provided Kestrel confirms the upfront Year 1 tranche (40%) and that a standard credit review (no-cost) completes before first invoice. If procurement needs Net 60 we would need a security mechanism (escrow or increased advance).
- Taxes: Thanks for the stub. We will require the signed tax residency certificate prior to final signature. We will add an explicit VAT/GST allocation clause in the order form: purchaser is responsible except where Redwood is statutorily required to collect. If Kestrel expects consumption in the EU or other jurisdictions, please provide the list of countries so we can map invoicing entity.

Attached: Decision_Log_OrderForm_20270517.xlsx (updated), Kestrel_Redline_OrderForm_20270516.pdf (marked with our commercial responses). Also attaching a short draft paragraph to capture the 0.5% admin fee and the Net 45 amendment language.

Next steps: If that aligns, can procurement confirm cadence + provide PO entity details and the signed tax cert by EOD Friday 21 May? Once we have that, Legal will finalize and route for signatures. Happy to take a 20m call to go through the amendments — propose Thu 20 May 10:00 AM PT if that works for you.

Best regards,
Ben Carter
Sr. Account Executive — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142
